correctness.rationale: The exact weighted entropy identity was symbolically verified in its scalar interaction block and checked across 700 full 3-species/2-nutrient exact-rational states. The polynomial is nonnegative via an explicit sum of squares. Strict local consumption makes the only invariant zero-dissipation set the coexistence equilibrium; coercive entropy gives compact positive sublevels and complete forward trajectories, so LaSalle proves global attraction, with uniqueness and the Hurwitz conclusion following. Finite tests are not treated as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: The source investigates the central question whether nutrient localization supports multispecies coexistence. A conditional globally attracting interior fixed point, for arbitrary numbers of nutrients/consumers, unequal positive species isolation and any exchange rate, rules out multiple interior attractors and oscillation basins that numerical equilibrium tests cannot eliminate. The explicit entropy cancellation provides a transferable structural dynamical constraint, not a narrow arbitrary numerical invariant.
